examples.english: Therefore he said to them, 'I will not call you my servants from now on because the servant does not know what his master is doing.

examples.coptic: ⲉϣⲱⲡⲉ ⲉⲧⲉⲧⲛϣⲁⲛⲧⲙⲣⲛⲟⲃⲉ · **ϫⲓⲛⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩ** · ⲉⲓⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲧⲁⲧⲉⲧⲛⲁⲁⲩ ϩⲛⲟⲩⲙⲛⲧⲁⲧⲥⲟⲟⲩⲛ · ϥⲛⲁⲕⲁⲁⲩ ⲛⲏⲧⲛ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ·
examples.english: If ye cease from the habit of sinning from this time [onwards], then the deeds which ye have committed through want of understanding He will remit to you
examples.source: Dormition of John MERC.AD in Budge ed.

examples.coptic: ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲁⲓ ϫⲉⲉⲓⲥϩⲏⲏⲧⲉ ⲁⲕⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ ⲙⲡⲣⲕⲟⲧⲕ ⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲉ ϫⲉⲛⲛⲉⲡⲉⲧϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉⲡⲁⲓ ϣⲱⲡⲉ ⲙⲙⲟⲕ · ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲁⲣⲓϩⲙϩⲁⲗ ⲙⲡϫⲟⲉⲓⲥ · **ϫⲓⲛⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩ** ϣⲁⲉⲛⲉϩ ·
examples.english: and he said unto me, “Behold, thou art healed. Sin not again, lest evil more severe than this come upon thee. But make thyself a servant of God from this time for ever.”
